title: How Large Real Estate Corporations Handle Increases
description: Official SEC EDGAR figures; portfolio-level evidence only, not SF-specific or a legal benchmark.

rows.label: Independence Realty Trust Q4 2025
rows.value: Same-store new leases -3.7%; renewal 2.9%; blended 0.8%; occupancy 95.4%; retention 61.4%

rows.label: IRT 2025 value-add
rows.value: 2,003 renovations; average $251/month increase over unrenovated comparables

rows.label: All large corporations generalization
rows.notes: No official source proves what all large corporations do.

rows.label: Essex Property Trust - San Francisco County Q4 2025
rows.value: 1,356 consolidated SF units; avg monthly rental rate $2,966 vs $2,897 (+2.4% YoY); occupancy 95.5%; gross revenue +2.0% YoY
rows.notes: County-level REIT evidence; not a legal benchmark for a rent-controlled unit.

rows.label: Essex Property Trust - portfolio lease tradeouts Q4 2025
rows.value: Similar-term net effective renewal +4.8%; new lease -2.4%; blended +1.9% (full-year 2025 blended +2.5%)
rows.notes: Portfolio-level; renewals above 1.6% reflect largely post-1979 stock outside SF rent control.

rows.label: Equity Residential FY 2025 Form 10-K
rows.value: FY 2025 Form 10-K on EDGAR (CIK 0000931182); multifamily REIT operating in San Francisco and other coastal markets
rows.notes: Resolves prior SEC search dead end (F15); portfolio-level only, not SF-specific rent data.
